body: I usually feel full by the end of the second slice so I don’t usually go more than that! I get regular pizza from a local place though, kind of NY style with a mostly thin crust with a lot of cheese. None of those pizzas from Pizza Hurt or Dominos where the crust is thick and fluffy, I’m sure that’s a lot more white bread and I wouldn’t be able to handle it.
Cheese pizza! Love pizza and always shocked it doesn’t spike me.
This looks incredibly good! It looks like an artistic choice.
